title: Deleting a datasource in the admin API actually removes it: it disappears from the admin list, immediately and after a discover refresh

criteria.given: an admin created a datasource through POST /rest/saiku/admin/datasources
criteria.then: DELETE /rest/saiku/admin/datasources/{id} removes it: the datasource is absent from the admin datasource list, and stays absent after a discover refresh

steps.name: the admin creates a probe datasource with a known id
deleting the probe datasource by id answers 200
the deleted datasource is gone from the admin datasource list

$.because: the deleted datasource must not be listed any more (not even under its decorated unknown_ key)

steps.name: the discover refresh runs after the delete
the deleted datasource has not been resurrected by the refresh

$.because: the .sds file must be really gone, so a refresh cannot bring the datasource back
